{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Off-by-one day in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (web UI)

Signal: Selected value one day behind the label. Repro: pick the first of the month and reopen.

OCCASION 1 — 2026-01-29:
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary only
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping unknown fields
- Fix: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #4489, branch fix/off-by-one-day-1
- Outcome: Job duration improved from 2 hours to 49 minutes
- Context: Same corner of code as earlier off-by-one day work

OCCASION 2 — 2026-07-07:
- Trigger: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit, failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #4946, branch fix/off-by-one-day-2
- Stack: TypeScript; covering test: ui/components/DatePicker.test.tsx
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 5.0 s to 272 ms

These are distinct issues with the same symptom in the same component, resolved separately with different fixes."}
